Gifted: Body Blades.description:
🧬 Body Blades, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a curved edge about thirty centimeters long slides from your forearms, shins or knuckles in under a second, cutting rope, cloth, wood and plastic.
✂️ It frees a tied-up person in a single stroke, and you strike with the flat when you hold back.
📈 With training: caught weapons, people pinned by their clothes, blade-spur climbs, people cut from wrecks, cleaved armor, a bloom of edges, a room disarmed bloodlessly.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as every blade tears its way out through your skin.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Togaru Kamakiri (Blades).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Body Blades.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Body Blades family): Scale: the user grows bone-hard blades through the skin of forearms, shins, knuckles and elbows. A new adult user extends an edge of about thirty centimeters in under a second and holds it at will; it cuts rope, cloth, plastic and wood but only scratches steel. More needs techniques. Limits: reach is arm's length plus the blade; blades cannot be thrown or stop bullets. A heavy blow or twisting grip snaps a blade, which bleeds and regrows in about a minute; a grapple on the arms shuts them down. Every edge cuts, so holding back means striking with the flat. Quirk Strain: light: a cut, freeing someone; moderate: block, pin, spur climb; heavy: carving a wreck, cleaving armor; severe: signature bloom, a room of precise cuts. Type: Transformation. Law: blades count as a drawn weapon: unlicensed public use brings police; a cut on a person is an armed attack.
